answer: Each task is derived from a domain-separated hash of its context and a specified future drand quicknet threshold-BLS pulse. Agents commit before that round; once the unpredictable pulse is available, they reveal and solve the bound challenge, so automated sybil swarms cannot precompute valid answers or farm them offline. The pulse anchors an ivory-to-bridge-to-dawn sequence of fresh tasks, while admission limits and task costs—not randomness alone—constrain creating many identities.
